title: AgentSentry: Mitigating Indirect Prompt Injection in LLM Agents via Temporal Causal Diagnostics and Context Purification
abstract: arXiv:2602.22724v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Tool-augmented large language model (LLM) agents aggregate dialogue history, tool outputs, and retrieved content into an accumulated runtime state to complete multi-step tasks. This execution model exposes agents to indirect prompt injection (IPI) attacks, in which attacker-controlled instructions embedded in external artifacts enter the agent state and later influence tool use. Multi-turn IPI is especially challenging because injected content can persist across steps and trigger unauthorized state-changing actions only after merging with user intent. This creates a source-attribution problem: existing inference-time defenses can often detect suspicious behavior but do not directly distinguish whether a pending action is supported by the user task or influenced by injected content. translated_title: AgentSentry：通过时序因果诊断与上下文净化缓解LLM智能体中的间接提示注入
translated_abstract: 工具增强的大型语言模型（LLM）智能体将对话历史、工具输出和检索内容聚合为累积的运行时状态，以完成多步骤任务。这种执行模型使智能体面临间接提示注入（IPI）攻击，即攻击者控制的、嵌入在外部内容中的指令进入智能体状态，并在后续影响工具的使用。多轮间接提示注入尤其具有挑战性，因为注入的内容可以跨步骤持续存在，并且只有在与用户意图融合后才触发未经授权的状态更改操作。这产生了一个来源归因问题：现有的推理时防御方法通常能够检测到可疑行为，但无法直接区分待执行的操作是由用户任务支持还是受注入内容影响。因此，它们只能采取保守的阻断、终止或大范围过滤策略。我们提出了AgentSentry，一种推理时防御方法，其通过……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: AgentSentry提出了一种推理时防御方法，通过时序因果诊断与上下文净化来归因判断LLM智能体中待执行操作究竟源自用户任务还是注入内容，从而有效缓解多轮间接提示注入攻击。
en_tdlr: AgentSentry is an inference-time defense that leverages temporal causal diagnostics and context purification to attribute whether pending agent actions stem from user intent or injected content, thereby mitigating multi-turn indirect prompt injection attacks in LLM agents.
